title: Sideview Battlers problem when changin resolution

posts.author: hyanmaru
posts.body:
Hello everyone, I’m trying to use the Sideview combat system in RPG Maker MZ, but after changing the game’s resolution, the battle sprites appear smaller and are positioned in the top-left corner. I suspect this is because RPG Maker MZ doesn’t automatically adjust for resolution changes in Sideview combat.
I installed the Battle Core VisuStella MZ plugin and adjusted the offset settings, which worked to reposition the sprites. However, the actors are too close to each other. I attempted to increase the spacing using notetags and by modifying the .js file directly, but neither approach made any changes in the game.
I tested the same setup in the VisuStella Sample Project, and it worked perfectly, so there’s clearly something wrong with my project. I tried uninstalling and reinstalling the plugin via the Plugin Manager, but the characters still didn’t move on the battle screen.This is becoming a slightly frustrating experience for me, haha. Can anyone help? Please let me know if you need more details
EDIT: I solved it thanks to Battle Core VisuStella MZ plugin.
For everyone interested, go to Plugin Manager > Battle Core > Actor Battler Setting > JS: Home Position and edit the value of y += index * [number];
